purpose: cluster-free single-gene and set-level marker validation of the atlas correspondence, both species, one object

independence_levels.1_held_out: all atlas marker genes removed from the panel
independence_levels.2_cross_lab: human only; Fitzgerald C12 also removed, then correlated against the Fitzgerald module
independence_levels.3_cross_species: mouse cells vs human atlas, orthologs only

CAVEAT: held-out is not statistical independence — genes co-express, so the claim is 'never given these genes and still predicts them', not 'knows nothing about them'. Cells within a sample are not replicates; per-sample distributions are the inferential statistic. Per-cell cosines are a new quantity, not the published cluster-level values.
